Players Committee card image of [[I Am Your Father (V) (ALT) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Deploy on table. [Death Star 2] Vader is deploy = 6. Once per turn, may deploy Vader's Lightsaber from Reserve Deck; reshuffle (or lose 1 Force to deploy it from Lost Pile). Whenever a lightsaber swung by Vader 'hits' a character, opponent loses 1 Force. Immune to NOOOOOOOOOOOO! [Immune to Alter.]”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/iamyourfather_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e083be48ab147a9c9a69d055ec2467a29b3f0225 e083be4] (24 January 2025). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
